_comment: 商品图工作流的模板化输入参数示例。修改这些值即可复用工作流，无需改动图结构。

positive_prompt.value: product photography, a ceramic coffee mug on a clean white background, studio lighting, soft shadows, high detail, 8k uhd, commercial product shot, centered composition

negative_prompt.value: blurry, low quality, low resolution, watermark, text, logo, deformed, distorted, bad anatomy, extra objects, cluttered background, harsh shadows, overexposed, underexposed, jpeg artifacts, noise

fixed_inputs_note: 以下节点为固定节点，不应在复用时随意改动：4 (CheckpointLoaderSimple 模型加载器)、图中所有连线 (wiring)。如需换模型，仅修改节点4的 ckpt_name，并确保模型文件已放入 ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/。
